notes:
Make it yours.

Your name — add one in Settings › You and the home screen greets you by it: "Good evening, Rain". Change or clear it any time.

Main source — pick which source Browse opens to in Settings › Browse. You can still switch sources from the pills whenever you like; this just sets your starting point.

Midnight theme — a new, optional pure-black night sky with the rain and distant lightning flashing behind it. Great for AMOLED screens and reading at night. Settings › Appearance › Midnight.

Also fixed: the rain could freeze into a still frame after toggling Lite mode off and on.
